description: Serial input before Serial.begin() is lost; input after it is delivered.
basis: Recorded once on Arduino Uno R3 (genuine, USB 2341:0043) (serial output, arduino-cli 1.5.1, arduino:avr@1.8.8). Previous basis: ATmega328P datasheet: the receiver ignores the RX pin while RXEN0 is clear; measured on an Uno R3 in docs/proposals/results/p1-14/serial_before_begin
